name: pickup-monorepo
description: Pickup — Cross-Platform Peer-to-Peer File Transfer Engine (AirDrop / LocalSend style)

scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web && node scripts/copy-dist.js
scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:desktop && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:server
